uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: When the user is damaged, their attack stat increases by 8% for 4s up to 4 times.

Becomes a boosted attack with increased range every third attack, hitting twice. The first hit damages opposing Pokémon with a normal basic attack; the second hit is a follow-up attack with a bone, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area a second time and throwing them for 0.5s.
No English description available in Unite-DB JSON.
Dashes forward, damaging opposing Pokémon hit.

The user receives 30% reduced damage and decreases their movement speed by 15% as they charge up power for up to 4s, reaching maximum charge after 1s; then dashes forward with a devastating punch when released, damaging the first opposing Pokémon hit, dealing additional missing HP damage to the target and shoving them for 0.5s. If this move hits, the user readies a boosted attack. This move's cooldown is reduced by 1s each time one of the user's moves lands a hit. If this move is canceled or not released after 4s, it goes on a 1.4s cooldown. When the user is mega evolved; the move can hit multiple opposing Pokémon and can be overcharged for an additional 0.4s to throw all opposing Pokémon it hits for 1s. 12% of Enemy Missing HP (caps at 1000 dmg).
Becomes unstoppable while charging this move.
Punches with the force of a meteor in the designated direction after 0.4s, damaging opposing Pokémon hit and shoving them in the designated direction, stunning those hit for 0.4s.

The user becomes unstoppable and rapidly punches in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area in front of them (up to 11 times), and restoring the user's HP each time this move hits. The next auto attack within 5s after using this move gains increased range and causes the user to lunge at an opposing Pokémon with a kick. When the user is mega evolved; the move lasts longer dealing damage up to 16 times reducing this move's cooldown by 0.4s for each hit on Pokémon from the opposing team, can be slowly rotated, the last hit can be targeted in any direction, and this move can be ended early, after channeling for at least 1s, by activating the move again or by using Power-Up Punch. The first hit of this move has 12x the normal healing. Hitting an enemy with Power-Up punch reduces the cooldown of this move by 1s.
Increases the damage of this move.

The user becomes unstoppable and channels aura into a huge sphere, then launches the sphere in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in its path. The aura sphere picks up speed as it travels; at close range, a target can be hit up to 4 times, while at max speed a target will only be hit once. After unleashing this move the user mega evolves for 25s adding additional effects to Close Combat and Power-Up Punch and changing the passive ability to Adaptability.
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6
